content: {"episode_id":"ep-05038","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10). Following a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack (G45.9), continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control. The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic monitoring, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial with retroactive authorization review."}
